author: Arnav
problem: Condo board members vote 'yes', 'no' or 'abstain' on a motion. It passes when more than half of the yes and no votes are yes; abstentions don't count. Return whether it passes.
bug_description: Uses yes * 2 >= yes + no instead of >, so a tied vote (or no votes at all) passes.

comments.accurate: Passes when a majority of the yes/no votes are yes; abstentions are ignored
comments.wrong_behavior: Passes when yes votes make up at least half of the yes/no votes; abstentions are ignored
comments.wrong_location: Vote threshold verified; ballots may need lowercasing before they're counted
